04 // Brand Strategy, Audience Architecture & Narrative Positioning DERIVED FROM XPM BRAND-STRATEGY & STORYBRAND (SB7) FRAMEWORKS
PHASE 1: BRAND TRUTH

The Foundational Reason for Being

Formed in 2023 in partnership with the NE Chamber, Tech Nebraska exists to convene technology partners, enterprise leaders, and policymakers around a single unified voice.

Core Belief: Nebraska is not a "flyover tech state"—it is a mission-critical crossroads where industrial endurance meets cutting-edge digital modernization.

PHASE 2: AUDIENCE ARCHITECTURE

The 3 Core Ecosystem Personas

1. Enterprise CTO/CIOs: (HDR, Union Pacific, Kiewit) Seeking regional tech talent, AI best practices, and enterprise peer networks.
2. Startup Founders: Seeking capital access, legislative incentives (BIA), and ecosystem validation.
3. State Policymakers: Seeking economic development, tech workforce retention, and statewide broadband competitiveness.

PHASE 4: MESSAGING PILLARS

The 3 Guiding Brand Pillars (P.10)

1. Connecting People: Fostering collision between leaders across ag, logistics, banking, and government.
2. Advancing Technology: Championing tech adoption from AI to IoT across Nebraska's legacy engines.
3. Elevating the Good Life: Ensuring Nebraska remains the best place in America to build high-wage, high-impact tech careers.

Tone of Voice Calibration & Anti-Slop Writing Standards
Brand Voice Dimension Strategic Definition How Tech Nebraska Sounds (DO) What Tech Nebraska Never Says (DON'T)
Authoritative & Credible Backed by enterprise data, legislative policy, and real enterprise leaders. “Proposed BIA funding increases from $12M to $15M in FY26–27 to accelerate founder capital.” “We are super excited to disrupt the innovative venture capital paradigm!”
Pragmatic Midwestern Grit Rooted in real Nebraska industries: rail, agriculture, construction, and healthcare. “Where prairie endurance meets enterprise AI. Real systems. Real economic return.” “Unlock the magic of the metaverse and unleash infinite ethereal web3 synergy.”
Community-Driven & Collaborative Elevating the whole state (Norfolk, Lincoln, Omaha, Kearney, Scottsbluff). “When technology leaders across sectors put their minds together, Nebraska leads.” “Tech Nebraska is the sole savior bringing tech to an otherwise empty wasteland.”
Forward-Leaning & Visionary Urgent about Nebraska's digital future without sounding alarmist. “We don’t just participate in the Midwest digital future—we build it.” “Nebraska is desperately falling behind unless you act right now.”
